fields.title: [memory-api][ticket-cli][spec-cli] Add shared nested workspace root resolution

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. memory-api exposes a shared resolver that maps an explicit workspace root, store root, or path inside a store to the canonical hidden store root for a requested store type. 2. ticket-cli and spec-cli both accept an explicit workspace-root input and reuse that shared resolver instead of duplicating nearest-store discovery logic. 3. From the context-engine repo root, callers can target the nested memory-api workspace with ticket and spec commands without spelling the hidden .ticket or .spec path directly. 4. Focused regressions cover root-level targeting of nested ticket and spec workspaces and preserve existing nearest-store fallback behavior when no explicit workspace root is provided.

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. memory-api exposes one shared resolver that maps an explicit workspace root, store root, or path inside a store to the canonical hidden store root for ticket, spec, and rule workspaces. 2. ticket-cli, spec-cli, and rule-cli expose consistent global store-selection options, with one reserved spelling for targeting a workspace root and no duplicate or conflicting meanings for that same option name. 3. spec refs validate works from the context-engine repo root against the nested memory-api spec store without requiring duplicate workspace-root flags, and its file-resolution option uses a distinct, unambiguous name. 4. Focused automated tests cover nested root selection for ticket, spec, and rule CLIs plus the spec refs validation path, and the shared workspace spec is updated to document the cross-link and option-naming contract.

fields.validation_summary: Review finding on 2026-05-22: focused validation failed on Windows in memory-viewers/memory-api/tools/cli/spec-cli/src/cli/commands/refs.rs during refs_validate_prefers_explicit_code_workspace_root. The payload compared an explicit code-workspace-root rendered as C:\\Users\\...\\override against the expected normalized C:/Users/.../override form. Required follow-up: normalize explicit code-workspace-root handling in refs_validate payloads/tests to one path representation, rerun cargo test -p spec-cli workspace_root -- --nocapture, and rerun ./target/debug/spec.exe --workspace-root memory-viewers/memory-api refs ae5ef697-0ee5-4f74-9dca-2cb268290dae validate --code-workspace-root . --json from the repo root.

fields.validation_summary: Implemented Windows path-normalization fix in memory-api/tools/cli/spec-cli/src/cli/commands/refs.rs by routing refs_validate workspace_root payload through memory_api::workspace::strip_verbatim_prefix before slash rendering. Added regressions: render_workspace_root_for_payload_normalizes_separators and (windows) render_workspace_root_for_payload_strips_verbatim_prefix. Runtime parity checks from context-engine root passed: ticket get with --workspace-root memory-api, ticket index-root override, spec get with --workspace-root memory-api, spec index-root override, rule list with --workspace-root memory-api, and spec refs ae5ef697 validate --code-workspace-root memory-api (valid=true, workspace_root=memory-api). Focused cargo lane partially blocked in this environment with rustc E0463 crate lookup failures (ticket-api:reqwest; memory-api:tantivy), so cargo test workspace_root/refs_validate reruns remain pending once toolchain/dependency artifacts are repaired.
